ValidationRule.description: Coach cannot select below status values for Customer Nudge Tasks: Customer Archived Auto Archived Read By Customer
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.Name == 'Customer Nudge', NOT($Profile.Name = 'Minimum Access - External Apps'), ISCHANGED( Status ), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'STATUS_AUTO_ARCHIVED'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'STATUS_CUSTOMER_ARCHIVED'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'STATUS_READ_BY_CUSTOMER')))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The status values (Customer Archived, Auto Archived, Read By Customer) cannot be changed manually.
